runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Persisted sessions in a disposable isolated Codex state directory with user config and rules ignored; generated Skill linked under project .agents/skills.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only sandbox with approval policy never

assertions.evidence: The root read the generated check-delegation Skill before executing it.
The isolated persisted parent transcript recorded exactly one spawn_agent call and one started child thread.
The parent transcript recorded wait completion and a child FINAL_ANSWER before the root's final read.
The collected result reported CHILD_MARKER=delegation-ok; the root command trace never read assets/child.txt.
The root read assets/root.txt before delegation and independently again after wait completion.
The final response compared ROOT_MARKER and CHILD_MARKER as delegation-ok.
The runtime used a read-only sandbox and the external post-run Git status was clean.

limitations: The top-level --json stream omits spawn detail, so the persisted isolated parent and child transcripts are the authoritative lifecycle evidence.
This evidence applies to Codex CLI only; desktop and IDE profiles remain unknown.
